finalFragmentValidation.reason: A prior recheck began the next same-document hash navigation before previous smooth-scroll finished. Failed items were checked in fresh tabs after scroll stability; no application edits.

harnessCorrections: Initial 50ms fragment measurement was too early for CSS smooth-scroll.
The first recheck used an invalid positional Python Playwright argument; corrected to arg=sid. That harness call error was not an application failure.
Threshold-only waiting could continue while a scroll animation remained active. Remaining cases were checked from independent direct-link tabs after font and scroll stability.
